goal: Prevent callers holding an HTTP request from arbitrarily mutating its internal state
Unify multi-step HTTP request parsing so internal state progression is fully encapsulated
agreement: Strong support for compiler-enforced state transitions and cleaner request parsing (janb84, jeanpablojp)
Verified by exhaustively testing disconnect conditions against master (jeanpablojp)
Concern that inlining request parsing duplicates buffer cleanup across catch blocks (winterrdog)

categories.name: rpc
why: P4 because it is an internal encapsulation cleanup with no external behavioral or performance changes
It prevents callers from mutating HTTP request state directly but does not affect RPC users
